recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-7631; historical release snapshots should not be rewritten, and FHIR-34525 is already represented separately on the combined branch.
issue_request: FHIR-7631 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for the DSTU1 Procedure resource. It asked for Procedure.device to be renamed to a clearer name such as targetDevice; the final resolution chose focalDevice because implementers could confuse the focal device with devices merely used during the procedure.
initial_application: Git commit 512b2462e336c8a6425e2f3dc1a8590403e6e39b, whose subject includes #7631, changed the old Procedure spreadsheet element names from Procedure.device, Procedure.device.action, and Procedure.device.manipulated to Procedure.focalDevice, Procedure.focalDevice.action, and Procedure.focalDevice.manipulated. The same commit updated a Procedure example from <device> to <focalDevice>. Later source refactors preserved those names in source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml.
additional_context: Procedure is active and approved in source/fhir.ini. Current Procedure notes and Procedure.used guidance point focal implanted or removed devices to Procedure.focalDevice.manipulated. A later FHIR-34525 reconciliation commit already corrected a stale Procedure.device reference in active Procedure notes, and corrected Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because current active core source already uses focalDevice consistently and no current-source Procedure.device or targetDevice remnants were found outside historical snapshots.

related_jiras.note: A later reconciliation fixed stale Procedure.used guidance from Procedure.device to Procedure.focalDevice.manipulated, confirming current-source consistency with the FHIR-7631 rename.
